# Smart Live TV
> Smart Live TV is a premium IPTV streaming service for the UK and global audiences, offering 230,000+ live TV channels, sports channels (including Sky Sports, TNT Sports, and international broadcasts), movies, and TV shows starting from £12/month. Includes a free 24-hour trial.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/): Overview of Smart Live TV IPTV service, channel counts, and features.
- [Buy Subscription](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/buy): Direct checkout page for IPTV plans starting from £12/month.
- [Pricing Plans](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/pricing): Subscription tiers (1, 3, 6, and 12-month packages) starting from £12/month.
- [Channels Directory](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/channels): Full list of available international channels, premium sports networks, and VIP categories.
- [Free Trial](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/free-trial): Direct sign-up page for the free 24-hour trial.
- [FAQ](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/faq): Answers to common questions regarding speed requirements, device support, and payment options.
